_metadata.rubric: owner's corrected rubric 2026-10-17: no minimum hint count, no board competition, generic allowed when natural to both words, compounds judged as compounds, initialisms allowed
_metadata.independence: I read only u04-blind-input.json; no other file under data/unlimited, no repository search, no web or API lookups were used.
